plan.title: File Watcher + Indexing Pipeline (Metadata Only)

task.description: Create VaultRegistry: in-memory path → (user_id, namespace) mapping. rebuild() reads all users from DB, creates mappings for /vaults/private/{username}/ and /vaults/shared/. resolve(filepath) returns (UUID, str) or None. SYSTEM_USER_ID constant (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) for shared namespace. Registry refresh on startup and user create/delete. PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY for multi-worker sync (vault_registry_refresh channel). Singleton pattern. On user creation, create directory at {vault.base_path}/private/{username}/ if not exists.
task.verification: VaultRegistry resolves private and shared paths correctly. Unknown paths return None. Refresh rebuilds mapping after user creation.
task.done-condition: VaultRegistry singleton resolves paths to (user_id, namespace) tuples, handles shared + private namespaces, refreshes on user changes

task.description: Create markdown parser and NoteTypeClassifier: parser.py — extract YAML frontmatter via python-frontmatter, extract [[wikilinks]] including aliases [[target|display]] via regex, return ParsedDocument(frontmatter, wikilinks, body, title, tags, folder). NoteTypeClassifier — infer note_type from: (1) explicit type: frontmatter field, (2) folder path rules (/projects/, /journal/ → project; /inbox/, /fleeting/ → fleeting), (3) tag rules (#fleeting → fleeting, #project → project), (4) default → permanent. Configurable via settings.yaml zettelkasten.note_types.
task.verification: Parser extracts frontmatter, wikilinks (with aliases), body from sample markdown files. NoteTypeClassifier correctly infers types from frontmatter, folders, tags, and defaults.
task.done-condition: Parser handles: standard notes, notes with YAML frontmatter, notes with [[wikilinks]], notes with [[target|alias]] links. Classifier covers all 8 note types.

dimension.name: knowledge
dimension.rationale: Wikilink regex edge cases, Zettelkasten type rules

task.description: Create file watcher and IndexQueue: watcher.py — watchdog Observer monitoring vault.base_path for .md file create/modify/delete/rename events. Debounce at vault.watch_debounce_ms (default 300ms). On event: VaultRegistry.resolve() → if resolved, enqueue; if None, log and skip. App-initiated writes set a skip flag (content_hash dedup). indexer.py — IndexQueue processes events asynchronously: parse markdown → create/update documents table record (path, content_hash via xxhash XXH64, note_type, frontmatter JSONB, title, folder, tags, word_count) → create/update wikilinks table records (source_doc, target_doc resolved by path, target_name). No embedding, no enrichment, no chunks in Phase 1. Delete events remove document + cascade to wikilinks. Rename events update path.
task.verification: Save .md file in vault → document record appears in DB within 5 seconds. Delete file → document removed. Rename → path updated. Wikilinks extracted and stored. content_hash dedup prevents double processing.
task.done-condition: Watcher detects all file events, IndexQueue processes them async, documents + wikilinks tables populated correctly, debounce works, app-initiated writes bypass watcher

dimension.name: testing
dimension.rationale: Filesystem event timing, debounce, race conditions

dimension.name: decomposability
dimension.rationale: Watcher and indexer coupled by queue interface

task.description: Create bulk initial indexing and progress endpoint: On startup (or user creation), detect unindexed vault (documents not in DB). Queue all .md files for processing. Track progress (current/total/eta). GET /api/v1/vault/index/progress (JWT auth) returns {active: bool, current: int, total: int, eta_seconds: int|null}. Returns {active: false} when idle. Create reconciler skeleton: reconciler.py with stub reconcile() method (full implementation Phase 2+). Wire watcher startup into FastAPI lifespan. Wire VaultRegistry rebuild into lifespan.
task.verification: New vault with 100 .md files → all indexed on startup with progress tracking. GET /api/v1/vault/index/progress shows correct counts during bulk indexing. Returns {active: false} when complete.
task.done-condition: Bulk indexing processes all existing .md files on startup, progress endpoint reports accurate counts, target 1000 notes in under 5 minutes (metadata-only)
